BATC-15 Guideline for Cyber Security of NPCIL Data in NPCIL Bids/Contr acts: With reference to the guidelines issued by CERT - In under Ministry of Electronics a nd Information Technology (MeitY) to ensure digital data confidentiality, following c yber security checklist (Annexure-1) is applicable for this Bid/Contract requirement where NPCIL data will be residing on Contractor Premises. Annexure 1: Cyber Security Checklist 1. Contractor shall implement and follow security measures as prescribed in CERT-In “Guidelines on information Security Practices for Government Entities”, a. Section-8 i.e. "Third party Access and Outsourcing" in any information processing or stora ge facilities and processes, handling NPCIL contract related documents. b. Section-9 "Secure Cloud Services" if NPCIL related data is being stored/hosted in cloud ser vices or Internet hosted servers. These measures shall include adequate logging if access f rom external location is being permitted. c. Section 10 i.e. "Hardening Procedures" on servers storing NPCIL related data. 2. As indicated in CERT-In guidelines, contractor shall implement information security measure s to protect all data pertaining to NPCIL from breaches, unauthorized disclosures and implem ent necessary restrictions on copying and printing the same, during the currency of contrac t and afterwards also (if data is preserved for reasons justified and accepted by NPCIL). On c ompletion of the contract, all information assets / data shall be handed over to NPCIL on com pletion of contract and deleted from contractor's storage devices unless preservation of certa in data is justified, and permitted by NPCIL, post contract. 3. As per the CERT-In guidelines, Contractor shall ensure 3rd Party Security audit (by CERT-In e mpanelled auditor) of ICT (Information and Communication Technology) infrastructure maint ained by contractor for NPCIL's contract or connected infrastructure to above mentioned NPC ILS related infrastructure, shall be carried out as per frequency prescribed. The report of audi t along with compliance to recommendation shall be preserved and submitted on demand. 4. CERT-In guidelines of incidents reporting shall be followed by the contractor. Any incident / E vent / Anomaly / breach in the IT asset deployed for/of NPCIL or Data related to NPCIL observ ed by contractor shall be reported to NPCIL within a reasonable period of time, as prescribed by CERT-In. 5. As per CERT-In guidelines NPCIL reserves the right to audit or to have audit carried out by thi rd parties on limited IT infrastructure/asset of contractor in case of any reported cyber sec urity incident or data breach of any type. 6. All information, drawings, designs and specifications generated for the contract shall, at all t imes, remain the absolute property of the Purchaser. 7. List of IT Assets used for project shall be readily available with contractor and revised on an y change. 8. Sub-contractor or other contractual manpower hired by Contractor shall also follow the Infor mation Security best practices and all clauses mentioned above shall be applicable to them also. Note: This checklist is based on “CERT – In guideline on Information Security Practices for Government Entities” available on CERT –In portal. Section-8 i.e. "Third party Access and Outsourcing" in any information processing or stora ge facilities and processes, handling NPCIL contract related documents. b. Section-9 "Secure Cloud Services" if NPCIL related data is being stored/hosted in cloud ser vices or Internet hosted servers. These measures shall include adequate logging if access f rom external location is being permitted. c. Section 10 i.e. "Hardening Procedures" on servers storing NPCIL related data. 2. As indicated in CERT-In guidelines, contractor shall implement information security measure s to protect all data pertaining to NPCIL from breaches, unauthorized disclosures and implem ent necessary restrictions on copying and printing the same, during the currency of contrac t and afterwards also (if data is preserved for reasons justified and accepted by NPCIL). As per CERT-In guidelines NPCIL reserves the right to audit or to have audit carried out by thi rd parties on limited IT infrastructure/asset of contractor in case of any reported cyber sec urity incident or data breach of any type. 6. Sub-contractor or other contractual manpower hired by Contractor shall also follow the Infor mation Security best practices and all clauses mentioned above shall be applicable to them also.
